verdict.rationale: Trivy's CLI supports `--exit-code` for CI gating and JSON output (trivy-probe-6, trivy-probe-8), and the probe run confirms exit-code-based gating in practice, but the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of severity-level (--severity) or confidence-based filtering flags to suppress low-value findings. missing for 10: dedicated docs/examples of --severity/--ignore-unfixed flags, confidence-threshold filtering, and independent confirmation that severity-based gating reduces noise without extra tooling.
